recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core follow-up is needed unless a future work group decision changes the general Timing event-use policy or reintroduces a distinct Observation eventTiming extension.
issue_request: FHIR-12896 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request to add Timing to Observation.effective[x] and remove the eventTiming extension, after confirming Timing could be used for past or ongoing event schedules.

additional_context: Observation is active in the current build via source/fhir.ini. Current source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml retains Timing on Observation.effective[x], the Observation-date SearchParameter includes Observation.effective.ofType(Timing), and searches of current Observation source plus the FHIR Extension Pack found no observation-eventTiming extension definition. Related Timing event-use issues FHIR-12637 and FHIR-13231 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because the current built source already satisfies the Jira resolution and there was no build-scope eventTiming extension to remove.
